# Documentation Conventions

## Rules
- Structure: `docs/{adr,cli,mcp,core,schemas}/`; nothing outside except root `README.md`, `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md`
- ADRs: MADR format in `docs/adr/`; sequential `NNNN-kebab-title.md`; never reuse numbers; `### Confirmation` always present; `### Spec` in `## More Information` links related specs
- ADR creation: every significant decision (multi-package, constrains future, non-obvious choice)
- CLI: every command documented in `docs/cli/` (purpose, flags, examples, exit codes); output/caching contract changes update docs in same change
- MCP: every tool/resource in `docs/mcp/` (input/output schema, examples)
- Core docs (`docs/core/`): `@specd/core` package reference — semantics/contracts; NOT integrator import guide
- Integrators (cli, mcp, API, IPC): import `@specd/sdk` only; no mixing `@specd/core` + `@specd/code-graph`
- `docs/core/index.md` + `docs/code-graph/index.md`: prominent callout — hosts start at `docs/sdk/`, import `@specd/sdk`
- `@specd/core` examples labeled plugin/core-only; MAY note re-export from sdk; MUST NOT imply integrators choose either
- `docs/sdk/`: only integrator Docusaurus entry (sidebar SDK, before package-reference); `@specd/sdk` single import surface; host bootstrap; kernel + standalone factories
- JSDoc on ALL symbols (not just exports): description, `@param`, `@returns` (omit void), `@throws`
- Composition API docs: update `docs/` when public surface changes; document `createX(deps)`, `createX(config, options?)`, kernel/builder roles, `CompositionResolver` path
- Template variable removal/rename or list/summary contract changes: update all affected `docs/` in same change

## Constraints
- Markdown files; ADR `NNNN-kebab-case-title.md`; sequential numbers never reused
- Significant decisions need ADR with `### Spec` subsection
- Specs may have `## ADRs` for provenance (not dependencies); specs depend on specs only, never ADRs directly
- ADR constraints enforced via spec first
- Doc changes in-scope: `docs/config/`, `docs/guide/`, `docs/schemas/`, `docs/adr/`, `docs/core/`, `docs/cli/` and any file with stale tokens
